p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: the official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens the updated official sources, so you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market Access Map (ITC): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health regulations this country sets for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: Taric: customs code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform is not flagged by a regulator before trusting it with money
p.espaces.rg_note: A website opens in its own language: Use the translation in your browser, or "Understand a document" for a document.For an important decision, ask a professional in the country.
p.espaces.cu_d: Duties, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: The guide to buying and selling between countries.24/24 ONE WORLD does not provide customs declarations: a licensed customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market Access Map (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: Taric: customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.cu_d3: Transportation documents: Waybill (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Proof of origin (to get reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (enterprises importing or exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: health or plant certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: the seller loads on the ship, then the risk and costs are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: Seller delivers to destination, buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Prohibited or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines.Such entries are rejected and can be reported (en).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service of your choice.

p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID document is often required, both for sending and for collecting.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Never send money to someone you just met online, or to "unlock" a prize, a package, a loan or a visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: Always check on their website when sending.
p.espaces.ds_d: Sell without stock: Find a supplier, find out the real price, stay within the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier sends directly to your customer, easy to start, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is allowed in your customers’ countries: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale/Supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your activity: business status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see trading rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting the rights of customers: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.

p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid courses that promise to make you rich quickly.
